name: encoding-reflection-test-export-of-a-function-value
description: A call through a package variable whose value is a function of the program hands its arguments to that function's parameters as a direct call does: a test passing a pointer to a value through the variable a test file initialises to a function that hands its empty-interface parameter to a reader outside the analyzed program sends the value out of the analysis as a direct call of a wrapper does, so a field of it nothing writes is reported at the reachability class possible, which the outside callee may fill, and not as certain.
